The design is fixed and all tests pass (`TEST PASSED`).

Two bugs were present in `rtl/crc8.v`:
1. The CRC update loop ran only 7 iterations instead of the required 8 (`for (i = 0; i < 7; ...)` → `i < 8`).
2. `valid` was checked before `clear`, giving absorption priority over clearing, when the spec requires `clear` to take priority (and discard the byte on `data` if `valid` is also asserted).
